name: Jane & Blanche at the beach

recommendedDisplay.address: Westward Beach, Point Dume · approximate scene area
recommendedDisplay.reason: The film’s beach scene is documented at Westward Beach in Malibu. This representative point on the sand replaces an offshore geocode. It identifies the documented beach area, not an exact actor or camera position.

verification: The record’s specialist source, Set-Jetter, explicitly identifies Westward Beach in Malibu and provides matched film/site photographs.
Independent specialist Movie-Locations identifies Jane and Blanche’s beach as Westward Beach, on Malibu’s west shore.
The source comparison image shows the beach along the cliffs with Point Dume beyond, consistent with the same beach corridor researched for Soberin’s house.
The proposed point lies on the sandy strip seaward of Westward Beach Road in the inspected Esri World Imagery tile, not on the road, cliff or offshore water.
USGS 1-metre elevation sample supports dry-land placement; the beach shoreline changes with tides and erosion. This is a deliberately approximate scene-area marker.
